message:
You know, there’s something satisfying about finally being the ‘prepared one’ in the family. Last winter, when the weather reports started warning us about a big storm, I decided to take action. I pulled out my trusty checklist and stocked up on everything from batteries to snacks. When the snow began to fall and power flickered, I was calm, sipping my hot cocoa while the rest of the family scrambled around looking for candles. 

It felt good to be ready, and I couldn’t help but chuckle as I shared my emergency stash with everyone. Who knew that being prepared could also mean being the family hero, even if just for a little while? Do you have any tips for staying ready during storm season? ☕
